arc.opening: You mentioned things were looking good at work.

turns.text: You mentioned things were looking good at work. What's been the best part of how it's gone?
I actually got the promotion I've been hoping for since spring — director of the whole team now.
Leading the whole team now — that's huge, congratulations. What felt different the moment you found out?
Honestly I just sat there for a minute. It didn't feel real until I called my sister.
You've been steadily building toward this all year, and it finally landed — congratulations again. I'd love to hear more about that call with your sister next time.

annotations.takeaway: You've been steadily building toward this all year, and it finally landed.
annotations.hook: hear more about that call with your sister next time
